injuries.icd_description: Contusion of other or unspecified sites of head

injuries.description: chest wall injury / chest wall pain with localized tenderness over right anterior chest wall near shoulder
source: On 13 July 2013, the plaintiff attended A&E of Tuen Mun Hospital (TMH). Medical examination revealed localized tenderness over right anterior chest wall near shoulder. The range of movement of his right shoulder was full. Chest X-ray revealed no fracture. The provisional diagnosis was “R chest wall pain”.
Medical examination at A&E of POH revealed tenderness over right upper chest wall. Chest examination was clear. The provisional diagnosis was “chest wall pain”.
injuries.icd_description: Injury of muscle, fascia or tendon at thorax level, unspecified

injuries.description: right shoulder injury with tenderness and limited range of movement due to pain
source: the plaintiff landed on his right shoulder and right face in the accident which happened at about 1530 hours.

Examined at A&E of POH, he was found to have swelling over right maxilla, swelling over right middle finger, and tenderness over right shoulder. The range of movement of his right shoulder was limited by pain.
The provisional diagnosis was “S/F with right shoulder injury”.
injuries.icd_description: Strain or sprain of shoulder joint

localized tenderness over right anterior chest wall near shoulder

treatments_received.treatment: dressing in form of sling to stabilize right shoulder
source: Plaintiff, I am satisfied, was given dressing in form of sling[4] to stabilize his right shoulder at A&E of POH on 4 July 2013 as was recorded in 3 photos taken at POH on the same day[5].

treatments_received.treatment: ambulance transport to A&E of Pok Oi Hospital
source: he called police for assistance at 1714 hours and later arrived on ambulance to Accident & Emergency Department (A&E) of Pok Oi Hospital (POH) at about 1746 hours.

treatments_received.treatment: X-ray of facial bone, right shoulder, right elbow and right hand; CT brain
source: X-ray of his facial bone, right shoulder, right elbow and right hand revealed no fracture. CT brain revealed no acute hemorrhage or skull fracture.
